items.title: Eddie Bert interviewed by Monk Rowe, Danbury, Connecticut, November 20, 2001
items.q: He used to be playing piano, you know, when we were rehearsing, at Sixth Avenue around 28th Street on the second floor.

ctx.x: Well I think Hall Overton did a fantastic job writing that music because he caught the spirit. He got it right. He used to be playing piano, you know, when we were rehearsing, at Sixth Avenue around 28th Street on the second floor. There was a lot going on there. But he used to play the piano and Monk would be in the other room dancing. And he’d say, “but when are you going to play the piano?” He said, “when the tempo gets right.” Yeah those rehearsals were something.
Wow. You have worked with some characters.
